block.guhs.reisbureau_balie.lore: Send one of your guhs on vacation here. He comes back with a postcard and a souvenir, and he can never get lost. Nyeg!
block.guhs.reisbureau_gouden_koffertje.l: For the true world traveler: ten stamps on your travel pass. There is nothing inside, but it shines beautifully.
block.guhs.reisbureau_koffertje.lore: A little suitcase covered in stickers from faraway lands. Looks cozy in the hallway.
A guh on the couch, for 24 hours. Hang it on the wall.
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_barbecuet: A little wooden bucket with a ladle. Pour water on the stones: tsss. Lovely.
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_camping.l: A tiny tent. Exactly one nap fits inside.
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_cruise.lo: How did that little ship get in there? Your guh does not know either.
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_efteguh.l: "Paper here, nyeg!" He is always hungry, but only for paper.
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_guhkenhof: A little vase with pink tulips from the Guhkenhof. They stay pretty forever.
A little gondola from Guhnice. Just lie down, somebody else pushes.
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_guhrijs.l: A small Eiffel Nibble Tower. You may not eat from this one either.
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_guhwaii.l: A little castle of Guhwai'i sand, with a flag on top. One room: a bedroom.
A real piece of Cheese Moon, with holes. Scientific proof.
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_kaasmarkt: Three cheese wheels on top of each other. Do not eat them, it is a souvenir. Really. Nyeg.
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_knuffelda: A woolly little sheep from Snuggledale. Does not say baa, but it is very soft.
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_lingsesdi: A little house on the dike, with a guh asleep in the garden. Hang it on the wall.
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_nomguh.lo: A snow globe from Nomguh with a tiny house inside.
A cushion of real Chonkwood moss. Smells like forest and like naps.
block.guhs.reisbureau_souvenir_wereldrei: The whole world on a stand. Your guh took a nap everywhere.
A little sign for next to the front door. Now your house is a vacation country.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_barbecuet: A little bathtub that always stays warm. Real steam comes off it.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_camping.l: A little fire that never goes out, with a marshmallow that never burns.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_cruise.lo: The life buoy of the cruise ship, with a golden anchor. Hang it on the wall.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_efteguh.l: A red mushroom with white dots. If you listen closely you hear a little tune.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_guhkenhof: Tulips in every color at once. Nobody knows how they do it.
A fancy mask with feathers and gold. Hang it on the wall.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_guhrijs.l: This little tower lights up, just like the real one at night. Très chonk.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_guhwaii.l: For the best surfer of the afternoon. Your guh mostly sunbathed on it.
A small rocket, ready for takeoff. Three, two, one... nap.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_kaasmarkt: The grand prize of the Cheese Market. Shines like gold, smells like cheese.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_knuffelda: The golden bell of the sweetest sheep of Snuggledale. Ting-a-ling, nyeg.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_lingsesdi: The same painting, but fancy. The guh in the garden sleeps just as soundly.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_nomguh: Snow Globe Where It Really Snows
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_nomguh.lo: It always snows in this snow globe. No shaking needed, which is nice.
A little lantern full of glowguhs. They give light and sometimes take a nap too.
block.guhs.reisbureau_zeldzaam_wereldrei: A golden globe that spins all by itself. That is how you travel without getting up.
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.balkonie: Hi boss! I am on vacation in Balconia. It looks a lot like home. The couch is the same. So is the fridge. I saw you walk by and waved, but you did not see me. Home is chonk too. Nyeg!
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.barbecuether: Hello boss! It is nice and warm everywhere here. I sat in the sauna until I was all soft. Then a bath with bubbles. I smell a little like peanut sauce now, but that is part of it. Wahoog!
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.camping: Hi boss! Putting up the tent took an hour. After that I was tired, so I lay down in it. Marshmallows over the fire in the evening. One of them was in my fur. I found it later. Yummy! Nyeg!
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.cruise: Ahoy boss! The ship has a buffet that never closes. I put a deck chair next to the buffet. The captain said I am the best passenger, because I never fall overboard. I only lie down. Nyeg!
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.efteguh: Hi boss! In the Efteguh stands Hungry Bulgy Guh. He shouts: paper here, nyeg! I gave him all my bits of paper. I skipped the roller coaster, the little boat went nice and slow. I fell asleep by the gnomes.
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.guhkenhof: Hello boss! So many flowers! The sign said: no lying in the tulips. So I lay next to them. My nose is yellow from sniffing. I am bringing a little vase for the table. Nyeg!
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.guhnetie: Ciao boss! In Guhnice you never have to walk anywhere. You lie down in a little gondola and somebody pushes. The gondolier sang a song. I sang along: nyeeeeg! He loved it, I think.
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.guhrijs: Bonjour boss! Guhris is very fancy. I ate a baguette that was longer than me. The Eiffel Nibble Tower is made of nibbles all over, but you may not eat from it. I asked. Twice. Nyeg!
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.guhwaii: Aloha boss! I wanted to go surfing, but the towel was so comfy. I did build a sandcastle. It has one room: a bedroom. The sea came to look and liked it too. Nyeg!
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.kaasmaan: Hello boss, this is the moon! It really is made of cheese, I checked. I checked a lot. There is one more crater now. Floating is nice: you lie down and yet you don't. See you tomorrow, nyeg!
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.kaasmarkt: Hi boss! At the Cheese Market you may taste everything. So I did. Everything. After that the cheese carriers had to carry me too. I am bringing a little stack of cheese wheels, if I do not eat them on the way. Nyeg!
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.knuffeldal: Hi boss! I petted a little sheep. Then the sheep petted me. Then we fell asleep together in the hay. The farmer said that happens here every day. Nyeg, what a nice place!
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.lingsesdijk: Dear boss! I am lying in the garden of House Lingsesdijk 86. A duck came by. That was all. The grass here is very good for chonking. I already took three naps and it is only half past one. Nyeg!
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.nomguh: Brrr, hi boss! Nomguh is white and cold and beautiful. Skiing did not work, so I rolled down the mountain. That was much faster, actually. Then hot chocolate by the stove and a four-hour nap. Nyeg!
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.om_de_hoek: Hi boss! I am around the corner. It is almost the same as before the corner, but a bit further. I saw a pebble. I will be right back. Nyeg!
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.vadswoud: Hello boss! There is moss everywhere in Chonkwood Forest. I sat down for a moment and then it was evening. The glowguhs turned the light on for me. I was allowed to take this moss cushion home. Wahoog!
book.guhs.reisbureau.kaart.wereldreis: Hi boss! I went all the way around the world. I did not see much of it, because the train, the boat, the balloon and the camel were so nice to sleep on. Exactly eighty naps. I counted them. Nyeg!
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.reisbureau_balie.des: With the Travel Stamp, paper and planks you make your own &dTravel Desk&r. It works exactly like the desk in the Travel Agency: every real day four new trips of 1, 2, 8 or 24 hours. One guh at a time may go, and he can never get lost.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.reisbureau_balie.tit: A Travel Desk for at Home
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.reisbureau_eerste_re: Send a guh on a real trip and collect him when he is back. He brings a &6postcard&r (right-click to read) and a &6souvenir&r for your house.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.reisbureau_kennis.de: Talk to the &dTravel Agent Guh&r behind the desk. He sends guhs on trips: they come back with a postcard, a souvenir and sunglasses on.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.reisbureau_koffer.de: A guh does not travel without a little suitcase. Bring the Travel Agent Guh &64 cheese nibbles&r for the road, &61 piece of wool&r as a little pillow and &61 piece of paper&r for the postcard.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.reisbureau_koffertje: A souvenir you already have becomes a &6stamp&r on your travel pass. At ten stamps the Travel Agent Guh gives you a &6Golden Suitcase&r.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.reisbureau_proefreis: Put one of your guhs at the desk and send him on the &dtrial trip around the corner&r. That takes five real minutes. Then collect him at the desk: you get the &6Travel Stamp&r!
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.reisbureau_vinden.de: Somewhere far away in the &dGuhmension&r stands a little white-and-pink house with a giant suitcase on its roof: &dTravel Agency "The Chonk Vacation"&r. The &6Super Compass&r shows the way (tab Cozy). There you can send your guh on vacation!
Every trip also has a &drare souvenir&r. The longer the trip, the bigger the chance: from 1 in 20 on a 1-hour trip to almost 1 in 3 on a 24-hour trip. Find one!
The cheapest trip: 24 hours on your own couch. Your guh really is away for a bit, though. More or less.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.barbecuet: Steaming nice and warm in the sauna of the Barbecuether. Your guh comes back shiny.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.camping.p: a little tent at Camp Chonky Tent
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.camping.u: Camping the way it should be: put up the tent, lie down in it, done.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.cruise.pl: a cabin on the Guh Sea
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.cruise.ui: A day and a night on a big ship with a buffet that never closes.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.efteguh.u: Fairy tales, roller coasters and a trash can that talks. Your guh mostly rides the little boat that goes slowly.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.guhkenhof: Flowers as far as you can see. No lying in the flowers. (Your guh lies in the flowers.)
A city with water instead of streets. Your guh gets rowed around all day.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.guhrijs.u: The city of love, baguettes and the Eiffel Nibble Tower.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.guhwaii.u: Sun, sand and a towel. Surfing is allowed, so is lying down.
a rocket to the Cheese Moon
By rocket to the moon. It really is made of cheese. Your guh is going to check that very carefully.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.kaasmarkt: Looking at cheese, sniffing cheese, carrying cheese and above all: tasting cheese. Your guh comes back round.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.knuffelda: Petting little sheep in Snuggledale. The sheep pet you back.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.lingsesdi: An hour of chonking in the garden of a little house on the dike. Nothing happens. That is the whole idea, nyeg.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.nomguh.ui: Sledding, snow and hot chocolate. Your guh usually just rolls down the mountain.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.om_de_hoe: the little street around the corner
Five little minutes: to the corner and back. To practice leaving and coming back.
A forest where even the trees yawn. Soft moss, no alarm clock.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.bestemming.wereldrei: All the way around the world in one day. That only works if you sleep a lot on the way.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.dagboek.vakantie: I went on vacation: %s. I wore sunglasses.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.gids.stap.1: Packing the little suitcase: bring the three things
gui.guhs.reisbureau.gids.stap.2: Send a guh on the trial trip
gui.guhs.reisbureau.gids.stap.3: Done: you have the Travel Stamp
gui.guhs.reisbureau.gids.uitleg: Send one guh at a time on vacation at a Travel Desk. Trips take real time; your guh is safe and always comes back, with a postcard and a souvenir.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.gids.zoek: Find the Travel Agency "The Chonk Vacation" in the Guhmension (Super Compass) and talk to the Travel Agent Guh.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.al_thuis: Your guh is home already, nyeg.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.bezig: A guh is already traveling. One at a time, nyeg.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.eerder: %s is home again. Without a souvenir, but happy to see you.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.eerst_agent: First talk to the Travel Agent Guh.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.geannuleerd: The trip was canceled: your guh was gone before he could leave. He is simply at home.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.geboekt: %1$s is going on a trip: %2$s. Have a nice trip, nyeg!
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.geen_guh: That guh is not near the desk.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.geen_plek: There is no free spot here. Make some room at the desk.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.guh_bezet: That guh cannot leave right now: %s
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.koffertje: Your travel pass is full: you get a Golden Suitcase! Wahoog!
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.niet_vandaag: That trip is not on offer today anymore. Have another look.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.nog_niet: Your guh is still on the way. Just a little patience!
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.staat_klaar: %s is back from vacation and waiting at a Travel Desk!
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.stempel: You already had that one: a stamp on your travel pass! (%1$s/%2$s)
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.terug: %1$s is back from %2$s! He is wearing sunglasses and has a postcard for you.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.melding.vast: This desk belongs to the Travel Agency. Make your own at home with a Travel Stamp.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.plek.klaar: %1$s (ready to collect at a Travel Desk)
gui.guhs.reisbureau.reispas.uitleg: A duplicate souvenir becomes a stamp. Ten stamps: a Golden Suitcase!
gui.guhs.reisbureau.slot.0: First talk to the Travel Agent Guh in the Travel Agency "The Chonk Vacation" in the Guhmension. The Super Compass shows the way.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.slot.1: The Travel Agent Guh first wants the little suitcase packed: bring him the three things.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.slot.2: First the trial trip around the corner, nyeg. After that all trips open up.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.tip.echte_tijd: Trips take real time. The trip simply goes on while you are not playing.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.tip.eerder: Your guh comes back right away, but without a postcard and without a souvenir. He does not mind.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.tip.heb_je: You already have this one: a duplicate becomes a stamp on your travel pass.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.tip.met_geluk: With a bit of luck your guh brings this rare souvenir, instead of the common one.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.tip.nieuw: You do not have this one yet!
gui.guhs.reisbureau.tip.proef: Your first little trip. Your guh only brings a postcard.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.tip.waarschijnlijk: Your guh almost certainly brings this, together with a postcard.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.uit.ver: Not nearby. Put your guh next to the desk.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.weg.een_tegelijk: One guh at a time may travel.
gui.guhs.reisbureau.weg.klaar: %s is back and waiting at the desk!
item.guhs.reisbureau_kaart_cruise: Postcard: Cruise on the Guh Sea
item.guhs.reisbureau_kaart_kaasmaan: Postcard: Trip to the Cheese Moon
item.guhs.reisbureau_kaart_kaasmarkt: Postcard: Day at the Cheese Market
item.guhs.reisbureau_kaart_om_de_hoek: Postcard: Trial Trip Around the Corner
item.guhs.reisbureau_kaart_vadswoud: Postcard: Afternoon Nap in Chonkwood Forest
item.guhs.reisbureau_kaart_wereldreis: Postcard: Around the World in 80 Naps
item.guhs.reisbureau_stempel.lore: From the Travel Agent Guh. Use it to make a Travel Desk at home. Lost it? The Travel Agent has another one.
quest.guhs.reisbureau.hallo: Welcome to Travel Agency "The Chonk Vacation", nyeg! I am the Travel Agent Guh. I send guhs on vacation. They come back with a postcard, a souvenir and sunglasses on. Would your guh like to get away too?
quest.guhs.reisbureau.klaar: He is back! Well? I bet he saw a pebble. Here is your Travel Stamp: use it to make your own Travel Desk at home. Then you do not have to come all the way here every time. Have a nice trip, nyeg!
quest.guhs.reisbureau.koffer: Great! But first the little suitcase must be packed. A guh does not travel without: %1$s cheese nibbles for the road, %2$s piece of wool as a little pillow and %3$s piece of paper for the postcard. Will you bring them?
quest.guhs.reisbureau.koffer_klaar: Nibbles, pillow, paper... the little suitcase is packed! Now a trial trip: put one of your guhs here at the desk and send him "around the corner". That only takes five little minutes.
quest.guhs.reisbureau.koffer_nog: The little suitcase is not full yet, nyeg. I need: %1$s cheese nibbles, %2$s piece of wool (any color will do) and %3$s piece of paper.
quest.guhs.reisbureau.optie.stempel: I lost my Travel Stamp, nyeg
quest.guhs.reisbureau.praatje.0: On offer today: four trips! Tomorrow four other ones. Have a look at the desk.
quest.guhs.reisbureau.praatje.1: Did you know a guh in Balconia just lies on your own couch? He still comes back rested.
quest.guhs.reisbureau.praatje.2: A duplicate souvenir is no problem: it becomes a stamp on your travel pass. Ten stamps and you get a Golden Suitcase from me.
quest.guhs.reisbureau.praatje.3: The most popular trip? Chonking at House Lingsesdijk 86. There is nothing to do there. Guhs love it.
quest.guhs.reisbureau.proef_nog: The trial trip is ready at the desk next to me. Put one of your guhs near it and pick "Trial Trip Around the Corner". Five little minutes, nyeg!
quest.guhs.reisbureau.proef_weg: Your guh is around the corner now. Exciting, isn't it? Collect him at the desk in a moment.
quest.guhs.reisbureau.stempel_heb_je: You still have your Travel Stamp, nyeg. Check your pockets.
quest.guhs.reisbureau.stempel_nieuw: Lost it? No problem, I have a whole drawer full. Here you go, a new Travel Stamp!
quest.guhs.reisbureau.uitleg: Very simple! You pick a trip, your guh grabs his little suitcase and off he goes. A trip takes 1, 2, 8 or 24 real hours. Time goes on even when you are not playing. Your guh is safe with me: he can never get lost. Every day there are four new trips.
structure.guhs.reisbureau.tooltip: Send your guh on vacation! He comes back with a postcard and a souvenir.
